items.title: Sam Stovall’s Warning: Consumer Spending Will Collapse the Moment Banks Tighten Credit
items.summary: Sam Stovall says sentiment surveys are a distraction and that one specific corner of the financial system holds the real on-off switch for consumer spending. The signals hiding in this earnings season will tell investors whether that switch is about to flip.

items.title: 3 S&P 500 Stocks with Open Questions
items.summary: The S&P 500 (^GSPC) is often seen as a benchmark for strong businesses, but that doesn’t mean every stock is worth owning. Some companies face significant challenges, whether it’s stagnating growth, heavy debt, or disruptive new competitors.

items.title: Berkshire ups Alphabet stake under Greg Abel, making it a top-3 holding
items.summary: Berkshire Hathaway (BRK-A, BRK-B), under new CEO Greg Abel, increased its Alphabet position, making the Google parent its third-largest U.S.-listed equity holding by market value, behind Apple (AAPL) and American Express (AXP). According to a new filing, Berkshire held roughly 106 million Alphabet shares, valued at $37.9 billion, as of the end of June. Recent reporting confirms Berkshire invested about $10 billion in Alphabet during the second quarter.

items.title: Berkshire Hathaway expands Alphabet stake and trims bank exposure in Q2
items.summary: Investing.com -- Berkshire Hathaway (NYSE:BRKb) aggressively expanded its stake in Alphabet Inc (NASDAQ:GOOGL) during the second quarter, signaling a deepening conviction in the technology giant’s strategic trajectory. items.title: SEC filing shows Softbank initiates stake in Capital One; sells 71.5% of its Taiwan Semi holdings
items.summary: Softbank Group Corp. unveiled a new ‌stake in Capital One and disclosed ‌that it sold 71.5% of its stake in Taiwan ​Semiconductor Holdings during the second quarter in filings with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission.  Institutional investors, including wealth management entities, endowments, ‌pension funds, ⁠hedge funds and others, are required to file a list of ⁠their holdings as of the end of each calendar quarter with the Wall Street ​regulator.  In the ​most recent quarter, ​ended June 30, ‌Softbank disclosed it had acquired 276,811 shares of Capital One, valued at $55.5 million, as of the end of the period.

items.title: AT&T’s CMO tied ‘brand love’ to the numbers CEOs care about. Customers are 3 times less likely to leave and much cheaper to acquire
